title: Resting-State EEG in Parkinson's Disease and Healthy Controls
description: This dataset comprises 358 resting-state EEG recordings from 312 participants with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls, collected under eyes-open conditions. It includes longitudinal sessions for some participants, along with demographic and clinical variables such as MoCA and UPDRS Part III scores. The data are formatted in BIDS using BrainVision EEG files, supporting research on neural correlates of Parkinson's disease.
methods_description: EEG recordings were acquired during eyes-open resting-state conditions using BrainVision format, with 63-64 channels referenced to Pz. Most recordings were sampled at 500 Hz, with a subset at 25,000 Hz. Sessions included clinical assessments such as MoCA and UPDRS Part III scores, and acquisition dates were de-identified while preserving intervals between sessions.
